question: The HCF of any set of 10 co-prime numbers is always
solution:
**Concept:**

Co-prime numbers are numbers that have no common factors other than 1.

**Calculation:**

We have a set of 10 co-prime numbers.

By definition, co-prime numbers have no common factors other than 1.

⇒ The Highest Common Factor (HCF) of any set of co-prime numbers is always 1.

**∴ The HCF of any set of 10 co-prime numbers is 1**
